title: सहिद कथाको परिवेशविधान {Sahid Kathako Pariveshbidhan}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कथाकार गुरुप्रसाद मैनाली प्रणीत ‘सहिद’ कथाको परिवेशको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । सामाजिक, आर्थिक तथा राजनीतिक समस्यालाई मुख्य विषयवस्तु बनाएर लेखिएको यस कथामा स्थानगत, समयगत र वातावरणगत परिवेशको खोजी गर्ने प्रयोजनमा यो लेख केन्द्रित छ । यसका लागि कथाका मुख्य तŒवहरूमध्ये परिवेशलाई सैद्धान्तिक अवधारणाका रूपमा उपयोग गरिएको छ । प्रस्तुत अध्ययनलाई गुणात्मक अनुसन्धान ढाँचा र विश्लेषणात्मक विधि अवलम्बन गरी निष्कर्षमा पु¥याइएको छ । यस अध्ययनमा कथाकारले कथामा प्रस्तुत गरिएका घटना र पात्रले कार्यव्यापार गरेका ठाउँ, समय र वातावरणसम्बद्ध भएर आएका उद्धरणका आधारमा कथाको परिवेशविधानलाई विश्लेषण गरी निष्कर्षमा पुगिएको छ । प्रस्तुत कथामा स्थानिक परिवेशका रूपमा नेपालभन्दा बाहिरको सहरिया परिवेशको चित्रण भएको छ । प्रमुख कार्य स्थलका रूपमा छिमेकी राज्य भारतको शिक्षा, स्वास्थ र यातायातको सुविधा भएको सहरलाई प्रस्तुत गरेको छ भने गौण कार्य स्थलका रूपमा गायरखपुरको रेल स्टेसन, सरकारी सेना र मुक्ति सेनाका बिच युद्ध भएको कोसी किनारको स्थान रहेका छन् । सूच्य परिवेशका रूपमा नेपाली ग्रामीण क्षेत्र पनि आएको छ । ऐतिहासिक समयसम्बद्ध घटनालाई कथामा प्रस्तुत गरेका कथाकारले कथाकालका रूपमा साढे चार महिनाको अवधिलाई कथ्यमा समेटेका छन् । बाह्यवातावरणगत परिेवेशका रूपमा राणकालीन सत्ता र सत्ताको आडमा समाजका अन्तर्तहसम्म विस्तार भएको सामाजिक विभेद, अशिक्षा, राजनीतिक निरङ्कुशता तथा आन्तरिक वातावरणका रूपमा सामान्य र विशिष्ट चित्तवृत्तिपरक वातावरणका माध्यमबाट कथाको संरचनालाई पूर्णता प्रदान गरेका छन् ।
american_english: In this article, the setting of the story 'Sahid' authored by storyteller Guruprasad Mainali has been studied. Written making social, economic and political problems its main subject matter, this article is focused on the purpose of exploring the spatial, temporal and environmental setting in this story. For this, among the main elements of the story, setting has been used as a theoretical concept. Adopting a qualitative research framework and an analytical method, the present study has been brought to a conclusion. In this study, on the basis of quotations arising in connection with the place, time and environment where the events and characters presented in the story carried out their actions, the setting-construction of the story has been analyzed and a conclusion reached. In the presented story, as spatial setting, an urban setting outside Nepal has been depicted. As the principal place of action, a city of the neighboring state of India possessing facilities of education, health and transport has been presented, while as secondary places of action there are the railway station of Gorakhpur and the place on the banks of the Koshi where war took place between the government army and the liberation army. As implied setting, the Nepali rural area has also appeared. The storyteller, having presented historically time-bound events in the story, has incorporated a period of four and a half months into the narrative as the story's time. As external environmental setting, Rana-era rule and the social discrimination, illiteracy and political authoritarianism that spread to the inner layers of society under the shelter of that power, and as internal environment, through ordinary and distinctive psychological environments, the storyteller has given completeness to the structure of the story.

informal_english: In this piece, Guruprasad Mainali's story 'Sahid' and its setting get a close look. The story is built around social, economic and political problems, and the article is really about digging into the where, when and atmosphere of it all. To do that, setting is treated as a theoretical idea among the story's main elements. The study is qualitative and analytical, and it reaches a conclusion. The analysis draws on passages tied to the places, times and environments where the characters act, to work out how the setting is put together. In the story, the spatial setting is an urban one outside Nepal. The main place of action is a city in neighbouring India with decent schools, health care and transport; secondary spots include Gorakhpur railway station and the Koshi riverbank where government and liberation forces fought. An implied setting is rural Nepal. The author folds a four-and-a-half-month stretch into the narrative as the story's time. Externally, Rana-era rule and the discrimination, illiteracy and political repression that spread through society under its protection shape the story; internally, ordinary and distinctive states of mind complete its structure.
